description: An envelope addressed to a `(owner, handle)` queue. Queues are the substrate primitive: the same shape carries direct messages (`owner == peer_did`, handle `inbox:default`), local captures (`owner == self_did`, handle `inbox:triage` etc.), and channel posts (`owner == publisher_did`, handle `channel:foo`). Routing rule is `owner == self_did?`: matching means stay-on-disk; non-matching means deliver to the owner's relay. Stamps are allowed on any envelope regardless of recipient — including self-attestations of one's own captures. In MVP the cryptographic stamp covers only the body, not the envelope. Legacy v0.2.x peer-letter envelopes that omit the `handle` field deserialize with a synthesized `inbox:default` for back-compat.

from.description: DID of the sender (the principal whose scribe composed this envelope).

to.description: DID of the queue *owner* — the principal whose machine this queue lives on. For direct messages this is the recipient peer; for local captures this is the principal themselves; for channel posts this is the publisher.

handle.description: Queue handle on the owner's machine, of the form `<namespace>:<slug>` (e.g. `inbox:default`, `inbox:triage`, `area:health`, `channel:book-progress`). Direct messages conventionally use `inbox:default`. Legacy v0.2.x envelopes omit this field; readers synthesize `inbox:default` for back-compat.

depth.description: Declared attentional depth. Gross = surface-level, can be acknowledged peripherally. Subtle = needs deeper engagement.

urgency.description: Declared urgency. Inflationary by nature; the receiver-published attentionEnvelope constrains what is accepted.

source.description: Free-form origin of the work (e.g. Claude session ID, manual, agent name). Useful for retrospective traceability.

cadenceHint.description: Optional advisory hint to the receiver about when to surface (e.g. `morning`, `weekly`).
